adding.description: What it adds (instances to create; removals are not credited before they happen).

allowed.description: False when any limited dimension would be exceeded: the deployment is refused.

used.description: In use now (instances, CPUs or bytes).

QuotaLimits.description: A quota: one limit per dimension, `None` meaning no limit.

dimensions.description: Only the dimensions this scope limits.

QuotaScopeKind.description: Which level of the tenancy tree a quota belongs to.

QuotaUsage.description: Resources in use or asked for, in Incus's units.

QuotaView.description: A scope's quota, its use and the quotas above it.

bound.description: The tightest quota of the scopes above (a tenant may not set more).

oneOf.description: `None`: this scope has no quota of its own.
Use beneath this scope as Incus reports it; `None` with `usageError` when it could not be read.

Readiness.description: What to run inside the instance and how long it may take.

command.description: Program and arguments, as an argument list (no shell). Exit status 0 means ready.

timeoutSecs.description: Longer than this counts as failing (1–15, default 5).

RebalanceMove.description: One replica to move so a module is spread again.

live.description: A virtual machine moves while it runs. A container stops briefly, then starts.

RecoveryAction.description: What becomes of one instance of a failed member.

target.description: The member it restarts on (as chosen now; the job chooses again when it runs).

RecoveryMember.description: One failed member: its fencing and what happens to each of its instances.

confirmedBy.description: Who confirmed the server is powered off, when someone did.

decidedAt.description: When the recovery decision was recorded (once per failure).

failure.description: The failure record; `None` until the supervisor has seen it.

lastHeartbeat.description: Incus's last heartbeat from it (RFC 3339), when its message gives one.

status.description: Incus's status (`Offline` while it is failed).

name.description: The name it will have as a cluster member.

oneOf.description: Defaults to `manual`.

systemId.description: For a `maas` machine: its MAAS system id (from `GET /api/v1/provisioners/maas/machines`).

blocked.description: Why removing it now is refused; empty when it may proceed.

RestorePlan.description:
What restoring a volume from one of its backups would do (the dry run of a restore). The
restore copies the backup over the volume (an Incus `refresh` copy): everything written since
the backup is replaced and the volume's own snapshots are deleted, so a safety backup of the
current data is taken first unless the person says otherwise.

backupTakenAt.description: When the backup was taken (RFC 3339): everything written after it is replaced.

blocked.description: Why the restore cannot run now; empty when it can.

member.description: Member of a member-local pool; empty on a standalone server.

running.description: Of those, the ones running now: they must be stopped first.

safetyBackupPool.description: The pool a safety backup of the current data goes to; `None` when none is taken.

snapshotsDeleted.description: The volume's own snapshots, which the restore deletes.

steps.description: What the restore job will do, in order.

volume.description: The volume to overwrite (Incus name): what to type to confirm.

confirm.description: The volume's Incus name again, typed by the person restoring it.

safetyBackup.description: Take a safety backup of the current data first (default true).

Role.description:
Who may do what. Every API route names the permission it needs; roles map to permissions
here and nowhere else.

scopes.description: Scope levels it can be assigned at.

expiresInDays.description: The successor's lifetime, 1–365 days; the old token's lifetime when omitted.

overlapMinutes.description: How long the old token keeps working, 0–1440 minutes; 60 when omitted.

baseVersion.description: The draft version this edit started from; omit only for the first save.

Schedule.description: How often something is done for a volume and how many results are kept.

everyMinutes.description: Minutes between two runs: 15 minutes to one week.

keep.description: How many of the scheduled results are kept: 1 to 50.

ScheduleState.description: A schedule as set, and how its last run went.

error.description: Why the last run failed; cleared by the next success.

oneOf.description: A named group of physical machines (a MAAS resource pool, if MAAS is adopted).

SectorInfo.description: One sector as the Servers area shows it.

credentialVars.description: For a registered sector: the variables that must name its identity's files.

detail.description: Why it is not connected, in a sentence.

home.description: The sector this control plane runs against (`APELORA_SITE`, `APELORA_SECTOR`).

members.description: Members of its cluster (1 for a standalone server); `null` when it did not answer.

url.description: Its Incus API; `null` for the home sector (`APELORA_INCUS_URL`, a setting).

items.description: The home sector first, then the registered ones by site and name.

note.description: Applications deploy only to the home sector in this version.

ServerInfo.description: Facts about the Incus server the adapter is talking to.

architectures.description: Architectures this server can run (`environment.architectures`); empty when unknown.

token.description: The API token of an automation identity, shown only here.

apiAccess.description: Can call the Apelora API (automation identities only).

credentialRef.description: Name of the credential in the backend's secret store (never the secret).

operations.description: The operation families this kind may perform.

ServiceStatus.description: A stateless module's service address: a load balancer over its healthy replicas.

endsBy.description: The absolute limit: the session ends then whatever happens.

idleEndsAt.description: When the session ends unless the person types before then.

lastActivityAt.description: When the person last typed (the start until they do).

SessionKind.description: What a person can open on a module.

connectPath.description: Path of the websocket, relative to the API.

provider.description: Where the instance lives: a `mock` provider's sessions talk to a labelled fake shell.

ticket.description:
Shown once. Present it as the `ticket.<value>` sub-protocol when opening the websocket;
never put it in a URL.

oneOf.description: Scheduled backups (into the backup pool, on another member); `null` turns them off.
Scheduled snapshots (`auto-…`, in the volume's pool); `null` turns them off.

SettingChange.description: One setting in a change: what it is now, what it becomes, and what to know first.

from.description: The value set now; absent when Incus's default applies.

to.description: The value after the change; absent when the setting is removed.

approvalTarget.description: The approval target to ask for (`POST /approvals`, action `cluster.sensitive_change`).

apiTokens.description: Whether API tokens are accepted (legacy platform-wide tokens).

directories.description: Directories people can sign in with (username and password), enabled ones only.

localAccounts.description: Whether people can sign in with a local account (username and password).

providers.description: The organisation's identity providers people can sign in with, in order.

directories.description: Directories (LDAP with TLS), each checked with a TLS connection now.

SiteReport.description:
The site this process is connected to, and whether a second site could hold another
deployment. One connected site is not a plan.

planned.description: A sector in another site was named. The deployment is not started.

consistency.description:
`crash-consistent` when an instance was running, else `stopped`: a snapshot of a
running database is what a power cut would leave behind.

Source.description: Where inventory data came from and when it was read.

StorageMemberUsage.description: One member's share of a pool.

locations.description: Cluster members it is created on; empty when unknown.

members.description: Use per member as Incus reports it; a shared pool lists the first member that reported it.

role.description:
What Apelora uses it for: `volumes` (`APELORA_VOLUME_POOL`), `backups`
(`APELORA_BACKUP_POOL`), or nothing.

shared.description: One pool every member reaches (clustered LVM, Ceph): its space is counted once.

oneOf.description: Used of total over all members (a shared pool once); `None` when no member reported it.

unreadable.description: Members whose use could not be read, with the reason.

oneOf.description: What Incus reports now; `None` when Incus could not be read.

backupPool.description: Where backups go; `None`: backups cannot be taken (`APELORA_BACKUP_POOL` is unset).

incusError.description: Why Incus could not be read (the list still shows Apelora's records).

SystemInfo.description: Facts about this control plane and the Incus release it is pinned to.

certificates.description: The certificates Apelora uses to reach Incus and when they expire (empty with the mock).

incus.description:
Incus as observed now: running version, clustering, or why it cannot be reached. (The
public `/api/v1/health` says only whether it is reachable.)

incusPinned.description: Incus release Apelora is tested against (`upstream.lock.yaml`).

incusSeries.description: Incus LTS series the pin follows, e.g. "7.0".

apeloraLimits.description: The limit keys Apelora last wrote to the Incus project.

canPrepare.description: The caller may create or adopt the Incus project now.

effective.description: The tightest of its own, its project's and its organisation's quota: what Incus gets.

oneOf.description: As Incus reports it; `None` when the project does not exist or could not be read.
This environment's own quota.

TenancyFinding.description: Something about an environment's Incus project worth knowing.

key.description: The configuration key it is about, if any.

TenancyIncusState.description: What Apelora knows about an environment's Incus project.

TenancyIncusView.description: What Incus reports for an environment's project.

TenancyLimitOutcome.description: What mirroring the quotas did to one environment's Incus project.

oneOf.description: Use of all its environments; only for callers who see the whole organisation.

adminConfigured.description: An admin identity is configured: Apelora can prepare Incus projects and set limits.

baseline.description: The configuration of a project Apelora would create now (restrictions and features).

oneOf.description: Use of its environments; `None` when one could not be read.

TenancyProjectUse.description:
An Incus project's use and limits (Incus's own aggregate of instance limits, root disk
sizes and volume sizes).

TenancyResource.description: One resource of an Incus project as `GET /1.0/projects/<name>/state` reports it.

limit.description: `None` when the project has no limit for it.

token.description: The token itself, shown only in this response.

confirm.description: `upgrade` to start or abandon; the member's name for the other actions.

member.description: The member, for evacuate, upgraded and restore.

UpgradeView.description: What the Upgrades tab shows, whether or not a run has started.

member.description: Whose turn it is, while a run is going.

order.description: Spares, then stand-bys, then voters, the database leader last.

beforeRestore.description: The restore job that took it just before overwriting the volume.

present.description: It exists in Incus; `None` when Incus could not be read.

scheduled.description: Made by the schedule (pruned to what the schedule keeps), not on request.

takenAt.description: When it was taken (RFC 3339): a restore brings back the data as it was then.

VolumeClass.description: The policy a volume is created under.

VolumeContent.description: What the volume holds: a mounted filesystem or a raw disk (virtual machines only).

incusName.description: The Incus volume (`<instance>-<name>`): what to type to delete it.

member.description: Member of a member-local pool; empty on a standalone server.

VolumeMount.description: A volume a module asks for.

name.description: Name in the design, e.g. `data`: lowercase letters, digits and `-`, at most 16.

path.description: Where a filesystem volume is mounted inside the instance; none for a block volume.

pool.description: The pool the class resolves to. Set by the control plane, never by a caller.

oneOf.description: `None`: no scheduled backups.
`None`: no scheduled snapshots.

VolumeUse.description: What Incus reports about a recorded volume now.

capabilities.description: Permission ids held at some scope (what the UI may offer; the server decides each request).

credential.description:
The credential this request was made with: `identity-provider` (an OIDC access token),
`session` (an Apelora session after a password or directory sign-in), `personal-token`,
`service-token`, `api-token` (legacy) or `development`.

deployProjects.description: Incus projects this control plane deploys into (`APELORA_DEPLOY_PROJECTS`).

id.description: The user or service identity id; absent for legacy tokens.

localAccount.description: Signed in with a local account (username and password): may change their password here.

permissions.description: What the older, coarse permissions amount to for this caller at platform level.

platformPermissions.description: Permission ids held across the whole platform.

oneOf.description: The role of a legacy API token; `null` for people and service identities.

roles.description: The role assignments in force for this caller.

bearer.description: An OIDC access token from the identity provider, an Apelora session (`apu_…`, after a password sign-in), a personal token (`apt_…`), an automation service token (`aps_…`) or a legacy API token (`apl_…`).
